title: IBM MQ: `queueManager` in trigger metadata is no longer read

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: IBM MQ Scaler: Remove and deprecate unused variables in IBM MQ scaler (#6033)
remediation: pkg/scalers/ibmmq_scaler.go at v2.16.0 no longer declares `queueManager` (the queue manager is part of the admin REST `host` URL), so the key on each ibmmq trigger named is ignored. Remove it; nothing else changes on this hop.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "ibmmq") and (.metadata // {} | has("queueManager"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row carries a key 2.16 ignores

title: Pulsar: the `msgBacklog` trigger key is removed — the threshold silently falls back to 10

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

remediation: Each pulsar trigger named still uses `msgBacklog`; from 2.16 only `msgBacklogThreshold` is read and the default of 10 applies, so the workload scales on the wrong backlog without any error. Rename the key before upgrading.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "pulsar") and (.metadata // {} | has("msgBacklog"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row scales on the default threshold after the hop

title: Admission webhook rejects two ScaledObjects that name the same HorizontalPodAutoscaler

detection.reason: whether two ScaledObjects set the same advanced.horizontalPodAutoscalerConfig.name is a cross-object comparison the projection does not make

quote: the HPA '%s' is already managed by the ScaledObject '%s'
remediation: Each ScaledObject named sets a custom HPA name (`advanced.horizontalPodAutoscalerConfig.name`). From 2.16 the webhook refuses an object whose HPA name is already owned by another ScaledObject — give each its own name, or drop the custom name so KEDA derives `keda-hpa-<name>`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items | group_by(.metadata.namespace + "/" + (.spec.advanced.horizontalPodAutoscalerConfig.name // ("keda-hpa-" + .metadata.name))) | .[] | select(.[1] != null) | "\(.[0].metadata.namespace) hpa \(.[0].spec.advanced.horizontalPodAutoscalerConfig.name // ("keda-hpa-" + .[0].metadata.name)) claimed by \([.[].metadata.name] | join(","))"'  # each row is an HPA name two ScaledObjects fight over

title: IBM MQ: `tlsDisabled` is documented as deprecated — use `unsafeSsl`

detection.reason: checked on the ScaledObject/ScaledJob triggers the agent projects (trigger type + metadata KEY names, never values) — a key supplied through a TriggerAuthentication or an environment variable is not a metadata key and is not scanned

quote: `tlsDisabled` - Can be set to 'true' to disable TLS. (DEPRECATED: This parameter is deprecated as of KEDA v2.16 in favor of unsafeSsl and will be removed in version v2.18, Values: `true`, `false` , Default: `false`, Optional)
remediation: Docs-only: the 2.16 scaler docs deprecate `tlsDisabled` in favour of `unsafeSsl` (the code's own flag is `tls`, announced in 2.17 and refused in 2.18). Each ibmmq trigger named carries a key no release reads — replace it with `unsafeSsl: true|false`.
verifyCommand: kubectl get scaledobjects.keda.sh,scaledjobs.keda.sh -A -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | . as $o | .spec.triggers[]? | select((.type == "ibmmq") and (.metadata // {} | has("tlsDisabled"))) | "\($o.kind) \($o.metadata.namespace // "-")/\($o.metadata.name) trigger=\(.type)"'  # each row carries the key the 2.16 docs deprecate
